title: Cookies and your privacy
body_web: We need essential cookies for the site to work, for example to keep you signed in. If you allow it, we also use Google Analytics to see how the site is used, without names, exact locations or chip numbers; nothing is sent to Google before you decide.
necessary_body: They keep you signed in, remember your language, your cookie choice and report drafts, and protect against abuse. Providers: Najdimo and Cloudflare (bot check). Durations are listed in the <link>cookie policy</link>.
analytics_body_web: They help us understand which pages and steps are used, so we can improve searching. Provider: Google (Google Analytics 4). The _ga and _ga_* cookies are kept for 2 years and the data in Google Analytics for 14 months. We do not use advertising cookies.
ads_note: We count ads without cookies and without any data about you, so this needs no consent.
reask_changed: Something has changed since your last choice: {change}. Please choose again.
reask_year: It has been a year since your last choice. Please choose again.
body_app: The app needs to store a little data on your device to work, for example to keep you signed in. If you allow it, we also use Google Analytics for Firebase to see how the app is used, without names, exact locations or chip numbers; nothing is sent to Google before you decide.
analytics_body_app: They help us understand which screens and steps are used, so we can improve searching. Provider: Google (Google Analytics for Firebase). Data is kept in Google Analytics for 14 months. We do not use advertising identifiers.
